title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
author: L. Frank Baum
summary: A Kansas farm girl is swept by a cyclone to the land of Oz. To get home she must follow the yellow brick road to the Emerald City, collecting a scarecrow, a tin woodman and a lion along the way.
readIf: you want a short, quick, imaginative classic that differs a lot from the famous film.
skipIf: you want something with emotional depth or complex plotting, as it is a simple, episodic children's story.

pairings.reason: Another classic of a girl in a strange land, with more word-play and less of a clear mission.
A later portal fantasy with a clearer moral struggle and a more serious tone.
Another early children's fantasy with pirates, fairies and a bittersweet look at home.
